name: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform
tagline: European electricity market data: generation, load, prices, and cross-border flows
description: Official ENTSO-E REST API for European power-system transparency data under EU Regulation 543/2013. Covers actual and forecast generation, load, day-ahead and imbalance prices, transmission outages, and cross-border physical flows. Access is free with a self-serve security token; responses are typically XML (with optional JSON for some document types).

auth.details: Security token as query parameter securityToken=YOUR_API_KEY (or Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY on some clients). Free self-serve registration on the Transparency Platform; request a token from account settings after email verification.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free with registered security token; no published paid plans. Practical limits are rate-based (see rate_limits), not request quotas per day.

rate_limits: 400 requests per minute per user account (API token), not per IP. Exceeding the limit may temporarily ban the token; automatic unbanning occurs after approximately 10 minutes.
use_cases: fetch day-ahead electricity prices for a bidding zone
get actual total load for a control area over a period
list generation by production type for a country
query cross-border physical flows between zones
retrieve planned and unplanned generation outages
pull imbalance prices for settlement analysis
